newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Bomb experts sift grounded plane's hold.
newsitem.headline: Bomb experts sift grounded plane's hold.

text.p: Irish army bomb disposal experts checked the cargo hold of an Air France Airbus on Friday after the plane was diverted to Ireland after a bomb scare.
Police said the bomb disposal crew was concentrating on an object in the cargo hold after verifying the luggage of some 220 passengers overnight.
They denied Irish media reports that a suspicious object had been found.
"There's no suspicious object with wires hanging out or anything," a spokesman said.
The plane was on a scheduled flight from Paris to Mexico city when it was forced to land at Ireland's transatlantic terminus after a bomb warning on Thursday.
